about: AP Chemistry concept dependency map (docs/apchem-spec.md, docs/apchem-phase0.md): the 91 CED topics in CED order, the math refresher skills with the topic each comes before, and every concept with the topic that teaches it and the concepts it depends on. Our own words; no CED text. Checked by scripts/check-apchem-map.mjs.

ced.effective: Fall 2024; exam on this framework since May 2025
ced.note: Built from docs/apchem-ced-map.json, itself from docs/apchem-research/framework.md. Units 3-9 exclusions unverified (docs/apchem-needs-author.md).

everydayWords.about: Common words a student already roughly knows from regular chemistry. They may be used in their everyday sense before the topic that teaches them; technical terms of the same concept stay strict.

circularDependencies.problem: Photoelectron spectroscopy (1.6) knocks electrons out with light, before 3.11-3.12 teach the electromagnetic spectrum and photon energy.
circularDependencies.detail: A one-line short version: a photon is a packet of light energy, and higher-energy light can remove an electron. 3.12 owns E = hν and the calculations.

circularDependencies.problem: Vapor pressure (3.3) is defined by the dynamic equilibrium between evaporation and condensation, and pre-equilibrium (5.9) needs equal forward and reverse rates, before Unit 7 teaches chemical equilibrium.
circularDependencies.detail: A short version: two opposite processes at equal rates, so nothing changes overall. 3.3 owns the plain word "equilibrium"; 7.1 owns chemical equilibrium, equilibrium concentrations and position.
